facts.claim_text: Obtain repeat blood cultures to assess ongoing bacteremia and guide antimicrobial therapy.

facts.claim_text: Administer a 500 mL crystalloid bolus to support borderline mean arterial pressure and improve tissue perfusion.
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The most recent mean arterial pressure before the decision time is 82 mmHg (R50), which is within the normal range, not borderline low. Earlier values were also generally above 70 mmHg, so the records do not support the statement that the mean arterial pressure is borderline.
